description: This file defines an interface 'ILocalStore' within the namespace WPEFramework::Plugin, representing a local storage abstraction with methods for opening, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and removing entries. It also defines a shared pointer type alias 'ILocalStorePtr'.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: An interface class for local storage operations, including table management, entry manipulation, and retrieval.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Open or initialize the local store at the given path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Create a new table within the local store.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Set a limit on the number of entries for a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieve the count of entries within a range from a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Get a list of entries from a table starting at a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Remove entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Add a new entry to a specified table.
